title: Langfuse And LangChain AI Engineering
summary: Learn how production LLM applications are built, traced, evaluated, and governed with LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, and trusted AI risk practices.
audience: Engineers moving from LLM prototypes toward production-ready AI applications, from beginner foundations through principal review standards.

units.title: LLM Application Foundations
units.summary: Map the moving pieces of an LLM application: prompts, retrieval, tools, traces, evaluations, cost, and safety.

units.title: LangChain Building Blocks
units.summary: Practice the mental model for LangChain model calls, structured output, tool contracts, and RAG flows.

units.title: Langfuse Tracing
units.summary: Learn how to structure traces, observations, sessions, metadata, token usage, and debugging workflows.

units.title: Prompts Datasets And Evals
units.summary: Use Langfuse prompt versions, datasets, experiments, and scores to make LLM iteration measurable.

units.title: RAG Quality
units.summary: Diagnose retrieval quality, grounding, citation failures, and evaluation datasets for RAG systems.

units.title: Agents And Operations
units.summary: Review LangChain agents, LangGraph durability, human approval, tool authority, and production operations.

units.title: Risk And Governance
units.summary: Connect OWASP and NIST risk guidance to practical LLM application safeguards and incident response.
